title: Full Stack Developer - Freshers - Onsite
description:
**About VMax**
 VMax Health Tech is a dynamic, innovative startup revolutionising the health and wellness industry. Our flagship product, FitMom Club, delivers personalized fitness and wellness solutions to mothers worldwide. We are a passionate team committed to creating impactful digital experiences and fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking enthusiastic Fresher Full Stack Developers who have completed a recognized Full Stack Development certification and are eager to begin their career in software development. The ideal candidate should have strong programming fundamentals, hands\-on exposure through academic, certification, internship, or personal projects, and a willingness to learn and contribute to real\-world products.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain web application features using React and Node.js under senior developer guidance
* Build responsive user interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js
* Work with MySQL databases (queries, data models, CRUD operations)
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and developers
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following best practices
* Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and issue resolution
* Use Git for source\-code management and collaboration
* Support integration between backend services and web/mobile applications
* Document code, APIs, and development work
* Continuously learn new technologies, frameworks, and practices


**Eligibility**
* Fresh graduates / entry\-level candidates are welcome
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, Computer Applications, or related field
* Full Stack Development certification is mandatory
* At least one full stack project completed (certification, internship, academics, or personal)
* Internship or practical project exposure preferred


**Required Skills**
* Good understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of React.js
* Basic knowledge of Node.js and Express.js
* Understanding of relational databases (MySQL)
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and client\-server architecture
* Familiarity with Git/version control
* Strong programming fundamentals, logical thinking, and problem\-solving ability
* Ability to debug basic frontend and backend issues
* Good communication skills and teamwork
* Strong learning attitude, ownership, and attention to detail


**Preferred / Added Advantage**
* Exposure to TypeScript
* Knowledge of MongoDB or Firebase
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Basic understanding of CI/CD, Docker, deployment processes
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development
* Understanding of UI/UX principles and responsive design
* Exposure to mobile application backend integration
* Participation in hackathons, coding challenges, open\-source projects
* Passion for health, fitness, and consumer\-focused digital products


**Certification Requirement**
 Candidates must have completed a Full Stack Development certification from a recognized training institute, learning platform, university, or equivalent program. The certification should include practical exposure to frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and project development.
   

  

**Culture And Commitment To Inclusion**
 At VMax Health Tech, we foster an inclusive, diverse, and fair workplace where every team member feels valued and respected. We believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our ability to serve clients.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
* Kickstart your software development career with live product experience
* Learn directly from experienced developers and product teams
* Gain hands\-on exposure across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and deployment
* Work in a collaborative and supportive startup environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Make a meaningful impact on products used by real customers

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full\-Stack Developer (8\+ Years)
 



 Location: Coimbatore
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Senior Full\-Stack Developer to build and scale a high\-performance AI/ML platform focused on workflow automation, model serving, data pipelines, multi\-agent orchestration, analytics dashboards, and enterprise deployments. The role involves end\-to\-end ownership across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and DevOps, working closely with AI engineers, product managers, and design teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Platform Architecture and Development:
 



 Design and develop scalable microservices, APIs, and backend systems for model serving, vector operations, workflow orchestration, and data pipelines.
 



 Develop modern frontend dashboards with real\-time analytics, admin controls, and user management features.
 



 Build modular and scalable services to support AI features such as RAG, embeddings, streaming inference, task queues, and evaluation engines.
 



**End\-to\-End Ownership** 




 Translate product requirements into scalable technical architecture and clean, maintainable code.
 



 Lead complex feature development while ensuring high code quality, test coverage, and CI/CD best practices.
 



 Optimize performance across services, databases, caching layers, and UI rendering.
 



**Systems Integration** 




 Integrate vector databases, LLM endpoints, Python ML microservices, authentication systems, event systems, and third\-party APIs.
 



 Build reliable communication layers between AI models, backend services, and frontend clients.
 



**DevOps And Deployment** 




 Manage cloud deployments on AWS or Azure.
 



 Implement containerization, autoscaling, monitoring, and logging solutions.
 



 Contribute to infrastructure automation using Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
 



 Ensure security, compliance, and data protection standards.
 



**Backend** 




 Required Skills and Experience:
 



 Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, or Python\-based backend frameworks.
 



 Experience building distributed systems, API gateways, streaming endpoints, or event\-driven architectures.
 



 Strong expertise in PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
 



 Exposure to vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or Qdrant is a plus.
 



**Frontend** 




 Advanced experience with React and Next.js.
 



 Strong skills in building dashboards, workflow builders, visual editors, and complex UI interactions.
 



 Experience with WebSockets, server\-side rendering, and performance optimization.
 



**Cloud And DevOps** 




 Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
 



 Experience working with cloud\-native services on AWS or Azure.
 



 Ability to automate deployments and implement secure DevOps practices.
 



**Engineering Excellence** 




 Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, API lifecycle, scalability, and reliability.
 



 Excellent debugging, testing, and documentation practices.
 



 Experience working in fast\-paced, product\-driven environments.
 



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience in AI/ML platforms, data engineering, workflow automation, or developer tools.
* Familiarity with model serving, embeddings, fine\-tuning workflows, and LLM integrations.
* Exposure to agent\-based systems, message queues, background workers, and observability stacks.
* Knowledge of RBAC, multi\-tenant architecture, subscription billing, or SaaS platform engineering.



  





**Core Attributes** 



* Strong ownership mindset and ability to take features from concept to deployment.
* Comfortable handling ambiguity and defining technical direction.
* Clear communicator with strong collaboration skills.
* High attention to quality and engineering discipline.
